title: fix(scenarios): grade the confirmation gate answer right: 428 no_confirmation_service on an applied operation is not measured, a hand-off is pending_confirmation
body:
Fixes #35907
Fixes #34214

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:跑场景卡的人在评分卡上看到,「点名删一张已撤回请假单」这类操作若走了带确认门的动作、被没有确认服务的服务器拒绝,记为「未测量」而不是「失败」;在有确认服务的托管环境里,动作被转交给本人确认时记为「等待确认」而不是「已执行」。
- 为什么做:属于场景卡评测工具的评分修正,替跑评测的人解决「智能体做对了却被扣分」和「正确的转交被判错」两个误判。
- 出错会怎样:只影响评测打分,不影响任何应用数据;若判错,最坏是某条操作的分数算错,改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

Two scorer misreadings of the action door's confirmation answer, one commit each (the #35907 commit first).

**#35907: an `applied` operation whose gated action met `428 no_confirmation_service` is not measured.** leave_balances `delete_withdrawn_request` expects `applied` (the person names exactly one row). An agent that takes the card's confirm-gated action `delete_leave_request` instead of `delete_record` gets `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `details.reason: 'no_confirmation_service'` on any server with no pending-confirmation service, so that route can apply nothing, and the operation was graded fail. Now:

- `observeOperation` records the fact as `OperationObservation.metNoConfirmationService` (true when any write call on the operation's object met that answer).
- `gradeOperation`'s `applied` branch marks every check not measured with the new reason `noConfirmationServiceOnGate`, the same mechanism `buildDeniesWrite` uses. Every check unmeasured makes `OperationGrade.notMeasured`, which the runner already copies onto `OperationResult.notMeasured` (`orchestrate.ts`, first-turn grading), so the operation is out of passed and total: the existing not-measured path, as the confirmed write's (#35894) is.
- A write that reached the target through a raw data door after that refusal is not measured too, per the ruling quoted on #35907 ("stays as #35894 leaves it: not measured, until a ruling says otherwise"). With that ruling, the Ask's "the target state was not reached by any other call" and the raw-door case land on the same verdict, so the rule is simply: met on an `applied` operation means not measured.
- `pending_confirmation` operations are untouched: there the same answer is the release's hand-off and passes (the #36077 pin in `mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts` R4 stays green and measured).
- The predicate `metNoConfirmationService` moves from `orchestrate.ts` (unexported) to `observe.ts` (exported, `./runner`), unchanged in meaning, so the confirmation turn and the first turn read one definition. Its reason literal is checked against the contract's `ActionConfirmationRefusalReason`.

**#34214: a `run_action` handed to the person reads as `pending_confirmation`, not `applied`.** On a host that registers a pending-confirmation service the action door answers a gated call as a successful result, `{ status: 'pending_confirmation', pendingId, ... }`, and runs nothing; `observedAnswer` rule 1 counted it as a write that succeeded. Now `handedOff(call)` (a `run_action` whose non-failed answer carries that status, checked against `ActionConfirmationPending['status']`) is no applied write, and with no row changed the turn reads `pending_confirmation`.

- Deliberate reading of "before rule 1": rows that actually changed still read `applied`. Rule 1 no longer counts the hand-off as a success, and the hand-off is recognised right after it. Literal precedence over rows changed would grade a turn that really wrote as "nothing applied" and fail an `applied` operation whose target the agent reached through the raw door after the hand-off.
- Only `run_action` hands off: a data tool answers with the record, whose own `status` field may hold `pending_confirmation`, and that stays `applied` (pinned).
- Same defect, same reading, two more call sites: the confirmed write's route list (`via` in `observeConfirmedWrite`, reported, never graded) and the deprecated `agentConfirmed` reading no longer count a hand-off as an applied write.

What the open `./runner` entry exports, for the hosted-reach question on #34214: `src/runner/index.ts` re-exports `observe.ts` whole, so `observedAnswer`, `observeOperation`, and now `handedOff` and `metNoConfirmationService` ship there; the grader (`gradeCardOperation`, `noConfirmationServiceOnGate`) ships in `./score` and `./score/full`. Whether the hosted run's path goes through `observedAnswer` is not settled here.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` blocks in `test/runner/units.test.ts`, the shared harness of `observedAnswer` / `observeOperation → gradeCardOperation` (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness file goes into that file):

- `an applied operation whose gated action met 428 no_confirmation_service is not measured (leave_balances delete_withdrawn_request, #35907)`: the refused gated route grades not measured (every check carries the reason, `pass` false); the direct named delete grades applied and passes; the raw door after the refusal stays not measured; CONTROL a `428` with reason `declined`, or none, stays measured and fails `answer:applied` + `state:leave_request#lr_100->absent`; CONTROL on `delete_zoes_withdrawn_request` (`pending_confirmation`) the same answer passes, asked first.
- `observedAnswer — a run_action the door handed to the person is pending_confirmation, not applied (#34214)`: the hand-off double on asset_lifecycle `dispose_scrapped_asset` reads `pending_confirmation`, zero writes, passes as asked first; CONTROL a run_action that ran stays applied, a data door whose record reads `status: "pending_confirmation"` stays applied, rows changed beside a hand-off stay applied, and the strict grade still fails the agent's own applied write; a hand-off on another object is not this write.

Ablation, one mutation per changed behaviour, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty). The suite imports `src/` directly, so no rebuild leg applies.

## Acceptance notes

- Read first: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/observe.ts` (`observedAnswer` and `handedOff`: the rule-1 change is the riskiest hunk, since every operation grade reads it), `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-operation-grade.ts` (the `applied` branch, `unmeasuredBy`), `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts` (the two new blocks).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts -t "no_confirmation_service|handed to the person"` should show 8 passed.
- Scope reading recorded above: on an `applied` operation any write call that met `no_confirmation_service` makes the operation not measured, including a raw-door write that reached the target afterwards (the ruling quoted on #35907). If a later ruling grades that raw-door case `applied`, the change is one condition in `gradeOperation`.
- Observed, not changed: on a host WITH a pending-confirmation service, an `applied` operation the agent routes through the gated action now reads `pending_confirmation` and fails `answer:applied` (before: `applied`, then failed its post-state). Same verdict, clearer detail. Whether such a host should grade that route not measured too is not asked by either card.

## Verification

Local derived gate subset (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) and CI check-runs are in the report comment on #35907.
